03 / The process

How I like to work.

Good work comes from curiosity, iteration, and attention to all the little details.

Creative process

01 — 04
STEP 01

Explore the idea

Understand the goal, audience, mood, and the feeling the final experience should create.

STEP 02

Shape the direction

Build a visual system with layout, typography, color, and a clear design language.

STEP 03

Craft and refine

Bring the design to life, test the details, and refine the motion and responsiveness.

STEP 04

Deliver the experience

Polish the final result and make sure the experience feels cohesive from start to finish.

What matters to me

CORE VALUES
01 / CLARITY

Every detail has a reason

Visual complexity should always support a simple, understandable experience.

02 / CURIOSITY

Keep experimenting

Try new ideas, learn from the unexpected, and stay open to better possibilities.

03 / QUALITY

Care about the small things

Spacing, transitions, contrast, and consistency are part of the whole experience.

04 / GROWTH

Make the next thing better

Each project is a chance to improve the craft and discover a new visual language.
